argument.name: minJumpsRace
argument.desc: If specified, filters sectors within X jumps of specified race.

argument.name: minJumps
argument.desc: Optional. Number of jumps used with minJumpsRace.

line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Mayhem.GetFactionStartingSector.xml
* DESCRIPTION: Returns a valid starting sector. Used by Phanon and Yaki.
* AUTHOR: DATE: 29 March 2026
* Arguments: $race, $minJumpsRace, $minJumps
* Initialization
* Phanon is allowed to pick from Yaki due to alliance (OCV plot branch).
* Sectors within $minJumps - 1 mean the candidate sector is too close.
*** Step 1: Prefer any unknown sector, excluding active and Renegade sector. ***
* Optional spacing filter.
*** Step 2: Otherwise, find a valid frontier sector. ***
* Don't choose the player ship's current sector.
* Don't choose the Renegade sector.
* Check owner. If not a compatible race (e.g., commonwealth + unknown), skip this sector.
* Don't choose a weak faction.
* Optional spacing filter.
* Save the first otherwise-valid sector as a fallback in case all candidates border clusters.
* Reject if the sector itself belongs to a cluster.
* Reject if the sector borders any relevant cluster.
* Unknown sectors are permissive here.
* Valid frontier sector found.
*** Step 3: Fallback if every valid sector is clustered or borders a cluster. ***
